items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: Six months practice frees from bondage.
items.inference: A qualified practitioner becomes fit for further teaching.
uncertainties: Exact case of kāṣāyaṃ depends on syntax.
items.plain_english: Whoever practices for six months, free from bondage, wearing the ochre robe.

items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: He is freed from all diseases.
He joins in union with yogis.
items.inference: The qualified practitioner enters yogic fellowship.
uncertainties: saha+melakam may be adverbial or accusative.
items.plain_english: Freed from all diseases, he has union together with yogis.

items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: This practice of the soul is told to you.
It is also told to you, O Bhairavi.
items.inference: The teaching has been communicated to the disciple.
uncertainties: etat may refer to preceding practice.
items.plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavi.

items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
items.inference: The essence is restricted to qualified recipients.
uncertainties: dātavyaṃ may agree with implied object.
items.plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.

items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: The kaula essence is not to be given.
It concerns the origin of yoginis.
items.inference: The kaula essence must be withheld from unqualified recipients.
items.plain_english: The kaula essence, the origin of yoginis, is not to be given.

items.question: To whom should the kaula essence be given, and to whom must it be withheld?
premises: It was struck by the veil of ignorance.
items.plain_english: Today my body, pure, was struck by the veil of ignorance.
